name: 45417 · Dayton, OH
findings: ZIP 45417 (Dayton) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45417 (Dayton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45417 (Dayton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
